correctness.rationale: Equation (1) is the exact coefficient matrix for the induced representation, with reflection points parameterized as as. Rank one is equivalent to UV=WX, and the linear independence of chi and chi^-1 prevents nonunique coefficient parameterization. The binomial equation has either 0, N/L, or N solutions according as the right side misses the image, lies in the image, or both coefficients vanish. Rank one rules out mixed complete-half and partial-fiber masks; explicit determinant-zero quadruples realize all masks. Double-fiber projective classes correspond bijectively to the two roots of W^2=alpha/beta, and whole-half classes to two pure entries. Other fibers contain infinitely many. Fourier rank follows from Schur orthogonality. A package-path checker passed 80 characters, 3192 ordered double-fiber witnesses, and 2304 exact Gaussian-integer coefficient inputs; tests alone are not the proof.

value.rationale: For every fixed nonlinear isotype of every finite generalized dihedral group, the theorem completely solves a natural support-only inverse problem: which exact zero observation masks can arise, how many masks exist, and when the observation determines precisely two rather than infinitely many projective signals. The L^2+2L+3 law and four-valued support spectrum derive from a structural character kernel and determinant-one constraint, independent of the size and decomposition of the abelian kernel. This is a motivated infinite-family complete classification with an identifiability consequence, rather than an isolated numerical experiment or standard uncertainty corollary.
